subject: Workplace Skills
title: Spotting Unwritten Rules
description: A short lesson to help you apply Spotting Unwritten Rules.

hook.text: A new hire emailed the CEO directly on day two. Written policy allowed it. Unwritten culture did not.

buildup.text: Every workplace has rules the handbook doesn't cover: who speaks first, how disagreements surface.

discovery.text: Observe experienced colleagues for a month before forming habits. Their behavior reveals the real rules.

twist.text: Asking 'What should I know that nobody told me?' is the fastest way to surface hidden norms.

climax.text: Violating unwritten rules is forgiven once. The second time signals that you are not reading the culture.

punchline.text: The real rulebook is written in behavior, not policy.

quiz.question: How do you discover unwritten workplace rules?
options: Observe experienced colleagues and ask what nobody told you
Ignore them since they aren't official
